# anthropic_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists API key records (never the secrets). Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_api_keys" "active_production" {
  status       = "active"
  workspace_id = anthropic_workspace.production.id
}

output "production_key_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_api_keys.active_production.api_keys[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_by_user_id` (String) Filter by creating user id.
- `status` (String) Filter by status: `active`, `inactive`, `archived`, `expired`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Filter by workspace id.

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) API keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by_id` (String) Creator id.
- `created_by_type` (String) Creator type.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp, if any.
- `id` (String) API key id.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `partial_key_hint` (String) Redacted key hint.
- `principal_id` (String) Principal id.
- `principal_type` (String) `user_actor` or `service_account_actor`.
- `scope_type` (String) `workspace` or `organization`.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `workspace_id` (String) Scoped workspace id, if any.
